llm_response.reason: This website displays almost all major characteristics of a scam online shop: it lists outdoor apparel with consistently deep discounts, constantly claims 'free shipping', and provides no legitimate company, contact, or legal information (no Impressum, privacy policy missing/404, no business address, or phone). The site appears to spoof the reputable Karpos brand name, lacks transparency about its operators, and has SSL certificate problems. Such features strongly align with scam site behaviors targetting consumers with too-good-to-be-true offers and no accountability.
